scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:api-server && pnpm run build:igniteai && pnpm run build:mockup-sandbox
scripts.build:igniteai: env PORT=24115 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/igniteai run build
scripts.build:mockup-sandbox: env PORT=8081 BASE_PATH=/__mockup pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
